title: Genesis 3:16 — pain in childbirth, desire for husband, he will rule over you
summary: Genesis 3:16 in English with its Hebrew reference: God tells the woman He will greatly multiply her pain in childbirth, her desire will be for her husband, and he will rule over her.

text.text: 16 To the woman He said, “I will greatly multiply Your pain in childbirth, In pain you will bring forth children; Yet your desire will be for your husband, And he will rule over you.”

keywords: thy desire shall be to thy husband
